messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: addResourcePath doesn't work?
parts:
I am having some trouble with addResourcePath. I am running Windows 8, R 3.0.2 and Shiny 0.8.0

I used the following in my server.R before the shinyUI({...})

addResourcePath("hello","c:/temp/")

Now In my ui.R I included

,HTML("<script src = 'hello/hello.js'></script>")

my hello.js is one line of console.log("test"). But I got this error. I checked my spelling and everything seems to be in order. This is quite straight-forward so I am not sure what is the issue here. Please help!!

Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
